understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spikes.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT change the player's horizontal position, while gravity causes vertical movement. CLICK can remove a clickable tile without moving the player. Landing on a spike ends the attempt; failed attempts restart the level, with two attempts and up to 50 turns per attempt. UNDO can reverse a recent action when available.
